subproblem.title: Weak blow-up limits with convergent centres are minimizing cycles of ℝ^{n+k} (conditional on (MB))
subproblem.statement: Assume (MB) — the frozen type of the grandparent's registered dependency moving_blowups (the selected node's third leading hypothesis): for all n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k, U, N ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with 1 ≤ n, U open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold, (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T minimizing in U ∩ N, spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U, and for all x ∈ U, x_j → x and λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0, there are a strictly increasing φ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) such that blowUp T x_{φ(j)} λ_{φ(j)} ⇀ C in ℝ^{n+k} (ConvergesWeakly), MassMeasuresConverge holds for the same sequence, C is minimizing in ℝ^{n+k} and ∂C = 0. Then, for n, k, ℓ, U, N, T satisfying the same hypotheses (ℓ ≤ k, 1 ≤ n, U open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T minimizing in U ∩ N, spt T ⊆ U ∩ N, ∂T = 0 in U), every x ∈ U, every sequence x_i → x, every sequence λ_i > 0 with λ_i → 0 and every S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) with blowUp T x_i λ_i ⇀ S in ℝ^{n+k} (ConvergesWeakly), S is minimizing in ℝ^{n+k} (IsMinimizingIn S univ) and ∂S = 0 (BoundaryVanishes S).
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ (x : Euclid (n + k)) (xs : ℕ → Euclid (n + k)) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n), StrictMono φ ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun j => blowUp T (xs (φ j)) (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C ∧ MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp T (xs (φ j)) (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C ∧ IsMinimizingIn C univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes C) → ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ (x : Euclid (n + k)) (xs : ℕ → Euclid (n + k)) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n), x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') S → IsMinimizingIn S univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes S
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 2 of the selected node's supplied proof (parent 2(b): zero-scale currents are minimizing), together with its (0f) (uniqueness of weak limits). Simon 7.3.3, proof of (1), (8) (chapter-07.txt lines 443–462): weak limits of η_{x_i,λ_i#}T with λ_i → 0 minimize in all of ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Only hypothesis (MB) is used.
1. Apply (MB) to n, k, ℓ, U, N, T (with the given hypotheses), the point x ∈ U, the centres xs := (x_i), the scales lams := (λ_i) with their positivity proofs, and the convergences x_i → x, λ_i → 0. It yields a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) with ConvergesWeakly (j ↦ blowUp T x_{φ(j)} λ_{φ(j)}) C, IsMinimizingIn C univ and BoundaryVanishes C. The MassMeasuresConverge part is not needed.
2. Let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^{n+k}) (TestFormOn univ n) and put a_i := currentEval (blowUp T x_i λ_i) ω. By hypothesis, a_i → S ω. Since φ is strictly increasing, φ(j) → ∞ (StrictMono.tendsto_atTop), so a_{φ(j)} → S ω (Tendsto.comp). The sequence of step 1 evaluated at ω is literally j ↦ a_{φ(j)}, so a_{φ(j)} → C ω. Limits in ℝ are unique (tendsto_nhds_unique), hence S ω = C ω.
3. As ω was arbitrary, S = C (GeometricCurrentOn.ext).
4. Rewriting the conclusions of step 1 with S = C gives IsMinimizingIn S univ and BoundaryVanishes S. ∎
proof_key_steps: Apply (MB) at the limit point x ∈ U of the centres: a subsequence of the blow-ups converges weakly to some C minimizing in ℝ^{n+k} with ∂C = 0.
Weak limits are unique: along φ the evaluations converge both to S ω and to C ω, so S = C by GeometricCurrentOn.ext.
Transfer IsMinimizingIn univ and BoundaryVanishes from C to S.

audit.reason: Prose and type match. Applying MB and uniqueness of real-valued test-form limits proves S = C, transferring minimality and vanishing boundary without circularity.
